note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #13, Q3 2025 Trust in Government; exports mexico_2025_q3safety_govtrust.csv) keeps INEGI columns bp5_1_1, bp5_1_2, bp5_1_3 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0925.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); code 9 set missing by the Section V recode ('capture replace bp5_1_* = . if bp5_1_* == 9', commented 'Q3 Section V: trust in government levels (1-4 scale), applies to 2024 Q3 and 2025 Q3'). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q3 data dictionary labels BP5_1_1 'Confianza en el Gobierno federal', BP5_1_2 'Confianza en el Gobierno estatal/Gobierno de la CDMX', BP5_1_3 'Confianza en el Gobierno municipal/Gobierno de la alcaldia (CDMX)'; 3/3 agree with questionnaire 5.1 sub-items 1-3. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 3 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI 2025 Q3 CSV (23642 rows) after dropping code 9 -- 12/12 item x level counts (bp5_1_1 1/2/3/4 = 3377/11329/4770/3883; bp5_1_2 = 2107/11121/5496/4635; bp5_1_3 = 2185/10230/5123/5840); code 9 = 283/283/264; no blanks, so no skip routing; live 70096 rows, 23522 ids (120 respondents with 9 on all three drop out), no duplicate id x item. Step 3b, 2025 Q3 vs 2025 Q1 (batch_691), checked against the trim3 print, the 0925 diccionario, catalogos and the .do, not assumed: same question, same 3 sub-items, same 4-point scale (1 Mucha confianza .. 4 Mucha desconfianza, 9 No sabe / no responde), same read-aloud introduction -- but it moves from Seccion IV / 4.1 / CP3 to SECCION V. CONFIANZA EN LOS NIVELES DE GOBIERNO / 5.1 / CP5 because Q3 inserts Seccion IV. Relaciones familiares, so the INEGI codes are bp5_1_1..3, not bp4_1_1..3 (in Q3 2025 BP4_* is the family-violence block). Codes match 2024 Q3 (batch_682, also bp5_1_*); vs batch_682 the only difference in shipped text is the CP5 intro, which the 2024 Q3 print lacks. All 9 distinct shipped Spanish strings found verbatim in the trim3 text layer (checked on a 150-dpi render of p.7); catalogos bp5_1_1..3 labels identical to the print. Words: instructions = CP5 read-aloud text (printed 'CP5: A continuacion, le voy a preguntar sobre la confianza que le pueden generar los diversos niveles de gobierno.', the 'CP5:' label stripped); only framing text for the table's one section, so instructions, not section_prompt. section_prompt = 5.1 stem; item_text = sub-items 1-3. Kept as printed: trailing '?', '(CDMX)', the stem's '...'. Normalised: the render's wider gap in 'Mucha  desconfianza' (justification) shipped with one space, as batch_682/691 did. Stripped: question/sub-item numbers, dot leaders, |__| entry boxes, interviewer direction 'REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION', and the closing CP6 script on the same page. Options: 1-4 printed; 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (12/12). File is batch_691's with only table, section_id, item (bp4_1_ -> bp5_1_) and instrument ('primer' -> 'tercer trimestre', 'Seccion IV.' -> 'Seccion V.') changed (diffed: identical otherwise). Dictionary: Description ('Public trust in government institutions to address security concerns, Q3 2025') overstates it -- 5.1 has no security framing; Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q3 wave (file suffix 0925) -- same defect as the siblings. INEGI-side defect, no effect on shipped text: the 0925 raw CSV stamps PER = '0325' on all 23642 rows and the 0925 diccionario gives PER's range as '0325'. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_691 for every field (Spanish identical string for string, including the CP3/CP5 intro); nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, tercer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section V (question 5.1 and its read-aloud introduction) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text. Code 1 is the most trust (Mucha confianza) and 4 the least; in this quarter the items are coded bp5_1_1..3, while the same question in the 2025 first-quarter table is bp4_1_1..3.
